lines.text: God has spoken from His sanctuary:
and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine;
Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
upon Edom I toss My sandal;
over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
Who will bring me to the fortified city?
Who will lead me to Edom?
Have You not rejected us, O God?
Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
Give us aid against the enemy,
for the help of man is worthless.
With God we will perform with valor,
and He will trample our enemies.

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Transfiguration — Christ lifted up in white above the cloud with His arms open, God has spoken from His sanctuary, I will triumph
pictures.name: pd_raphael_the_transfiguration

pictures.scene: Jakob Philipp Hackert, View of the Tiber Valley with the Sabine Mountains — the whole valley laid out below with its river, its bridge and its flocks, I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth
pictures.name: pd_hackert_view_of_the_tiber_valley

pictures.scene: Benjamin West, Joshua passing the River Jordan with the Ark of the Covenant — the helmeted commander on the white horse with his arm raised and the tribal standards behind him, Gilead is Mine and Manasseh is Mine, Ephraim is My helmet and Judah is My scepter
pictures.name: pd_west_joshua_passing_the_river_jordan

pictures.scene: Garofalo, Christ Washing the Disciples' Feet — the basin set on the floor and the foot held over it in the Lord's own hands, Moab is My washbasin, upon Edom I toss My sandal
pictures.name: pd_garofalo_christ_washing_the_disciples_feet

pictures.scene: John Martin, Joshua Commanding the Sun to Stand Still upon Gibeon — the walled city on its height with the army winding up the road to its gate, over Philistia I shout in triumph, who will bring me to the fortified city
pictures.name: pd_martin_joshua_commanding_the_sun_to_stand_still

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, Desolation — one column left standing over the ruins of the city at moonrise with nobody in it, who will lead me to Edom, have You not rejected us O God
pictures.name: pd_cole_desolation

pictures.scene: Jan Willem Pieneman, The Battle of Waterloo — the field full of troops with the wounded carried back through the lines, will You no longer march out O God with our armies, give us aid against the enemy
pictures.name: pd_pieneman_the_battle_of_waterloo

pictures.scene: Jules Bastien-Lepage, Joan of Arc — the peasant girl standing in her father's garden with her hand out and her eyes on what has come to her, for the help of man is worthless, with God we will perform with valor
pictures.name: pd_bastien_lepage_joan_of_arc

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Limbo — Christ standing with His banner on the door He has broken down, the enemy pinned flat beneath it, and He will trample our enemies
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_limbo
